# The Pacific Crest Trail · เส้นทางแปซิฟิกเครสต์

> The PCT from Mexico to Canada, 2,650 miles. The trail drawn as a constellation at the real latitude and longitude of its towns and passes, under the current moon phase; photographs south to north; trail traditions; Burney Mountain Guest Ranch at mile 1411; two whole towns for sale (Belden, Campo) and trail lodges listed or sold, checked 28 Sep 2026; fire, snow, flood and weather map links; notable years.

- [English](https://nanobotco.github.io/pct/)
- [ไทย](https://nanobotco.github.io/pct/th/)
- Sections: #walkit (drag along the elevation profile: climb so far, Everests, steps, date, moon, daylight) #ridges (the profile in 27 lines of 100 miles) #bubble (a timetable chart of 300 modeled hikers, date against mile) #walk #burney #traditions #sale #conditions (live weather at 23 places, Open-Meteo; fires within 25 miles, NIFC WFIGS) #years #sources
- Data: PCTA 2026 mile markers and centerline, USGS 3DEP elevations, Halfmile's 489,418 ft climb, the Halfway Anywhere 2025 survey; tools/glean/ in the repository holds every number with its source and arithmetic.
